source_read: https://menus.tenkites.com/brg/slimscore?sitecode=SLM%20Basildon (core menu page re-downloaded 8 Oct) and https://www.slimchickens.co.uk/menus; re-running the script on the fresh pages reproduces data/source byte for byte
notes: All 94 published dishes compared with a second reader: 53 'build your own' dishes via the data-recipe JSON, 41 plain items via their modal tables (9 nutrient values each and the Contain/May Contain sets): no extraction error. Held back by this check: Plant Based Buffalo Sandwich Meal (named Plant Based but the page marks Milk contained). Notes: the page names the cereals (barley, wheat, oats) and the data does not carry cereal names for this chain (every gluten dish shows 'gluten'); the script's own kJ/kcal gate is 3.7-4.5, looser than the audit's, but no published dish is outside the audit's 0.93-1.07; the site is one branch's menu (Basildon, core menu: core/hubs/breakfast menus share recipes).
